appearances.whereabouts: At the Eye of the World; on the hilltop where Aginor died, then down the slope to the clearing with the great oak marking the Green Man's grave
appearances.notable_actions: Awakens from using the One Power; realizes he killed Aginor and believes he killed Ba'alzamon; struggles with fever, pain, and disorientation; reunites with his friends; lies about what happened to him; learns about the Horn of Valere, the broken seal, and the Dragon's banner; confronts Moiraine about being gentled; refuses to be used as a tool
appearances.demeanor: Initially disoriented and struggling with physical pain; transitions to relief at finding Egwene safe; becomes terrified and defensive when discussing his ability to channel; angry and defiant when Moiraine explains his situation; fearful of his friends' reactions
